title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-03-15
lineage: composite source 1: AUD>??>CD>EAC>SHN and source 2: SBD>MR>C>D>CD>EAC>SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough‑diamond soundboard recording with occasional audience bleed, but a historically charged show featuring stellar jams on The Other One, Eyes of the World and Playing in the Band.
ai_review.review: The March 15 1973 performance captures the Dead grappling with Pig Pen’s recent loss – the band plays in a tight circle, delivering long, focused jams that many fans cite as an “X‑factor” moment. The SBD portion is listenable despite mono patches, channel drops and a splice on Eyes of the World, while the audience track is largely unusable. Highlights include a monster Other One, a soaring Eyes of the World, a fiery Playing in the Band and a beautiful China Doll.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars for the musical performance despite consistent complaints about sound quality; the weighted average of ratings lands in the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: SBD is usable but suffers from mono sections, occasional channel drops, a noticeable splice in Eyes of the World and slight vocal distortion on Truckin' and The Other One; audience (AUD) portions are described as 'rough', with patches that drop to floor level.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First show after Pig Pen’s death, performed in a circle facing each other; first set feels heavy and unfocused, while the second set builds into extended jams that showcase the band’s emotional intensity.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is highlighted as spacey, intense, and includes several “meltdown” moments during The Other One and the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Loads of Phil on bass are noted, especially during the second‑set jams where he’s described as animated.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboards add spaciousness to the jams, contributing to the overall “X‑factor” vibe.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s drumming is praised for its intensity; however one reviewer notes a channel cut near the end of Playin' that affects the drum break.
